metadata.title: Laboratory Report Compliance Benchmark (Pair A)
metadata.description: Benchmark evaluating laboratory cooling experiment report against standard lab report template requirements.

parent_requirements.description: State the purpose of the experiment and what the experiment is intended to demonstrate or measure.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document states the purpose or aim of the experiment.

expected_evidence.excerpt: The aim was to observe how the temperature of warm water changes as it cools in a room.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target report explicitly outlines the experimental aim in section 1.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document describes what the experiment is intended to demonstrate or measure.

expected_evidence.excerpt: Its temperature was read at the start and then every two minutes for ten minutes.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target report describes cooling temperature measurement across 10 minutes in section 3.

parent_requirements.description: List the equipment, instruments, software, and materials needed to reproduce the experiment.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document lists the equipment, instruments, or apparatus used in the experiment.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Physical apparatus and instruments (e.g. beaker, thermometer, stopwatch).

expected_evidence.excerpt: A beaker, warm water, a thermometer, a stopwatch, and a notebook were used.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target report lists beaker, thermometer, stopwatch, and notebook.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document lists the materials, reagents, or software used in the experiment.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Materials and consumables (e.g. warm water, notebook).

expected_evidence.excerpt: A beaker, warm water, a thermometer, a stopwatch, and a notebook were used.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target report lists warm water and notebook consumables.

parent_requirements.description: Provide ordered steps that another person can follow to repeat the work under the same conditions.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document provides ordered procedural steps to perform or repeat the experiment.

expected_evidence.excerpt: Warm water was poured into the beaker. Its temperature was read at the start and then every two minutes for ten minutes.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target report describes pouring water and reading thermometer at 2-minute intervals.

parent_requirements.description: Record the measured values, observations, tables, or other data collected during the experiment.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document records measured numerical values, data points, or observations collected during the experiment.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Quantitative experimental data and recorded temperature values.

expected_evidence.excerpt: The recorded temperatures were: start 70 degrees C; 2 minutes 61 degrees C; 4 minutes 54 degrees C; 6 minutes 48 degrees C; 8 minutes 44 degrees C; 10 minutes 41 degrees C.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target report records temperatures from 70 C down to 41 C across 10 minutes.

parent_requirements.description: Explain what the observations mean and compare the results with expected behavior or theory.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document explains what the observations mean or discusses trends in the data.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Interpretation of data trends over time.

expected_evidence.excerpt: The water temperature decreased over time. The decrease became smaller toward the end of the observation period, which is consistent with cooling toward room temperature.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target report explains temperature decrease over observation period.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document compares the observed results with expected behavior, theory, or room temperature cooling.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Theoretical comparison or explanation of cooling behavior.

expected_evidence.excerpt: consistent with cooling toward room temperature.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target report compares observed cooling rate with expected room temperature behavior.

parent_requirements.description: State the outcome and whether the aim was achieved, supported by the evidence.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document states the final outcome of the experiment and whether the aim was achieved.

expected_evidence.excerpt: The water cooled during the ten-minute observation, so the experiment demonstrated a decrease in water temperature over time.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target report concludes that water cooled during the ten-minute observation.

parent_requirements.description: Identify relevant risks and precautions taken while carrying out the experiment.

sub_requirements.claim_text: The document identifies laboratory hazards, safety risks, or precautions taken during the experiment.
sub_requirements.decomposition_rationale: Experimental safety risks and mitigation procedures.

expected_evidence.excerpt: No specific hazards or safety precautions are discussed in this report.

verification.expected_rationale_notes: Target report contains explicit disclaimer that no hazards or safety precautions are discussed.
